summary: Diff implements parts of REQ-7/REQ-8/REQ-9 on the frontend (new admin automation page/route, brand image hooks + header logo binding, editorial theme styling, image fallbacks). Backend changes add new types/state placeholders (ingestionSources, brandImage, lastIngestionTimestamp) and a migration, but the core ingestion automation (fetch/parse/dedup/status/daily trigger) and full source CRUD schema required by REQ-4/5/6 are not evidenced in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: CRUD a list of content sources with at minimum: name, URL, default category, enabled flag; fetch enabled sources over HTTPS, parse deterministically, ingest only new items (no duplicates), enqueue as posts mapped to existing categories; per-source failures don't block others; errors recorded in a retrievable admin status log.
missing_requirements.reason: Backend source schema shown does not include required fields (name/default category/enabled), and the diff summary does not show any HTTPS fetching, RSS/JSON parsing, deduplication, category mapping, or admin-retrievable error/status logging implementation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Daily automated ingestion trigger plus an admin-only manual trigger; last run time and last run outcome (success/partial/failure + counts) queryable by admins.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calls actor.triggerAutomatedIngestion(), but the diff summary does not show backend implementation of this method, any daily scheduling mechanism, nor any queryable last-run outcome/counts APIs; only a lastIngestionTimestamp variable is visible without outcome/stats.

missing_requirements.requirement: For each ingested item, set/refresh hero image URL from item when available or fall back to category image; normalize/validate stored image URLs to frontend-loadable paths; keep frontend fallback behavior.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend fallback behavior is implemented (onError fallback in UpdateCard/PostDetailPage), but there is no evidence of backend ingestion logic that derives image URLs from feed items, applies rules, normalizes/validates URLs, or sets post.imageUrl during ingestion.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin automation settings screen includes: manage sources (add/edit/enable/disable/remove), 'Run ingestion now', and a status panel showing last run time, counts, and recent errors.
missing_requirements.reason: A guarded AutomationSettingsPage and source add/remove + trigger ingestion hooks are shown, but there is no evidence of edit/enable/disable UI controls, nor any status panel that displays last run time/counts/recent errors returned from backend.

hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not request breadcrumbs; this changes site UI structure (even though routes remain intact).
